premises.text: A significant portion of the population lacks internet access, which can hinder social and economic growth
premises.evidence_span: 66% of the world has a smartphone in their hands, but 53% of the population does not have access to internet

premises.text: Current efforts to connect remote areas are not scalable
premises.evidence_span: we don't feel that this is scalable, we don't feel that this is going to actually get to a lot of people real soon

premises.text: BridgeFi enables apps to function offline by creating mesh networks using Bluetooth
premises.evidence_span: BridgeFi is an SDK that apps integrate onto their own code so they can work offline

premises.text: The mesh network can extend the range of communication beyond individual device limits
premises.evidence_span: the way BridgeFi works is that it connects phones directly using their Bluetooth antennas

premises.text: BridgeFi's technology is unique in the market with Android to iOS integration and encryption
premises.evidence_span: we are the only ones in the market with Android to iOS integration, we are encrypted, and we are patented

premises.text: Developers can monetize their apps based on monthly active users utilizing BridgeFi technology
premises.evidence_span: we charge based on monthly active users that use your app, thanks to our technology, each month

premises.text: BridgeFi aims to establish a standard for offline communications to improve lives and connect communities
premises.evidence_span: we want to build the standard for offline communications by building versatile products that improve and save people's lives

value.text: BridgeFi enhances communication access in critical situations, potentially saving lives
value.evidence_span: being able to connect with rescue corps or being able to connect with their teachers

notes: Traction metrics and team details excluded as they do not constitute premises.
